svg.title: Coral Reliquary — Shell, wave and pearl stations inside a coral-encrusted ruin
svg.desc: Three carved conduit stations step toward the unique pearl lens. Reading shelves and stone benches support short hops; the archive rubbing order remains visible from the central landing.
